items.title: Introduction: qualitative and quantitative analysis (kya hai aur kitna hai) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the unnumbered introduction, printed page 323.

blocks.text: Analytical chemistry woh science hai jo chemicals ki characterization (pehchan) karti hai. Kisi compound ki poori pehchan mein do type ka analysis (jaanch) shamil hai: qualitative aur quantitative. Qualitative analysis mein chemist yeh dhoondta hai ke compound mein kaun se elements maujood hain. Quantitative analysis mein yeh maloom kiya jata hai ke har element kitni amount (miqdar) mein hai.
Poora quantitative analysis aam taur par chaar bare steps (qadmon) mein hota hai:

items: Jis cheez ko naapna hai (desired constituent) use baqi cheezon se alag karna
Measurement (napna) karna aur result ka hisab lagana

blocks.text: Is chapter mein kuch basic separation techniques (alag karne ke tareeqe) bataye gaye hain jo lab mein practice ki jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Ek student safed powder ko flame test aur precipitation reactions se check karta hai, phir us ka tola hua sample titrate karta hai. Kaun sa hissa qualitative hai aur kaun sa quantitative?
blocks.explanation: Flame test aur precipitation reactions batate hain ke powder mein kya hai: yeh qualitative analysis hai. Sample tolna aur titrate karna batata hai ke koi cheez kitni hai: yeh quantitative analysis hai, jo chaar steps par chalta hai: sample, alag karna, napna aur hisab, conclusion.

items: Qualitative analysis: kya maujood hai. Quantitative analysis: kitna maujood hai.
Quantitative analysis ke chaar steps: sample lena, alag karna, napna aur hisab, conclusion nikalna.
